set -e; EXPECTED=72cc290a261432588005f0300ace382aa252deb1; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon >/tmp/aicall-callend-build.log 2>&1; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/aicall-callend-install.log; grep -q Success /tmp/aicall-callend-install.log; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'; }; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; test "$(state)" = 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable >/dev/null; fi; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(state)" = 2 ] && break; sleep 1; done; test "$(state)" = 2; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_call_end_probe true --el call_end_wait_ms 120000 >/tmp/aicall-callend-watchdog.start 2>&1; grep -q 'Status: ok' /tmp/aicall-callend-watchdog.start; DONE=0; for i in $(seq 1 1400); do if adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'shizuku_call_end_probe_result:'; then DONE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; test "$DONE" = 1; RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null); printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'call_media_ended=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'workers_stopped_without_owner_close=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'prepared_after_end=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'active_after_end=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'heartbeat_after_end=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'call_end_fail_safe_ok=true'; test "$(state)" = 0; echo milestone_d_natural_call_end_watchdog_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; fi; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE"
